citations.quote: only A shares and ETFs are included in Shanghai and Shenzhen Connect. Other product types such as B shares, bonds, and other securities are not included

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Under Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Connect, only A shares and ETFs are eligible Northbound securities; B shares, bonds, derivatives and other product types are excluded — so a Hong Kong investor cannot trade Mainland single-stock options or other derivatives through Stock Connect, only the cash equities and ETFs.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Stock Connect: Only A Shares and ETFs — No Derivatives
